affected_validation.principle: Only explicit changed files and their tests gate this task.

capture_completion.principle: Every planned evaluation call needs an authenticated non-cancelled disposition.

promotion.principle: This capture supplies proposals; it never authorizes promotion.

scientific_value.principle: A value miss is null science and does not rewrite capture accounting.

field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Expected, observed and passed separately for required validation, safety and scientific value; never mark failed value as successful.
field_principles.call_manifest: Canary and evaluation identities, actual owned runtime, raw paths/hashes and immutable terminal call states.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured monotonic elapsed, never synthetic elapsed or sleep to pass a floor.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host CPU or owned CUDA runtime as measured; no new board execution in V646.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain each field without wrapping scalar gates or ordinary dictionaries.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Current independent verification state; critical findings set true and prevent promotion.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* names upstream/check, exact field, expected and observed value, including missing paths.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Precise free-text terminal outcome; distinguish accounting, null science and unavailable work.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Actual computation, with historical inference in explicitly labeled hash-bound sidecars.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Actual closed duration class; no duration padding.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any attempted current model load or generation, even failure.
field_principles.phase_spans: Disjoint measured load, generation, evaluation, validation and write spans.
field_principles.plan_capture_complete_score: One only for complete authenticated fresh schedule and independent reduction; output quality is separate.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact input, resource and required-field checks before dependent work.
field_principles.random_seed: Frozen development/evaluation/resampling seeds; null if truly inapplicable.
field_principles.repository_health: Dated unrelated failures kept separately from affected required validation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind exact code, settings, evaluator, inputs and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Every comparative unit/arm/metric/cost/failure/censoring disposition, not only pooled means.
field_principles.runtime_receipts: Lease identity, model hash, model-count/runner/device records and joined task-window GPU telemetry.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Frozen planned/attempted/completed/censored units and stopping rules.
field_principles.schema: Version this record and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Exact producer paths and immutable byte hashes; preserve original classes/flags.
field_principles.source_fidelity_rows: Each source request and candidate with entity/quantity/order evidence and parse/executor status.
field_principles.status: Terminal only after actual work and affected validation; never a success-shaped placeholder.
field_principles.usable_proposal_count: Actual schema-usable proposals; zero is a valid measured null, not invented model failure.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Exact command/scope/return code/elapsed/log hash for every required and diagnostic check, including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished retryable OWN work is partial; external unchanged absence is blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when the evaluator defines truth; independent code alone cannot remove circularity.

import importlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

marker = sys.argv.index("--exp7303-resolve-imports")
root = Path(sys.argv[marker + 1]).resolve()
sys.path[:] = [str(root / "python"), str(root), *sys.path]
resolved = {}
for name in sys.argv[marker + 2:]:
    module = importlib.import_module(name)
    resolved[name] = str(Path(module.__file__).resolve())
print(json.dumps({"resolved_imports": resolved}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
allowed = (root / "python").resolve()
raise SystemExit(any(not Path(value).is_relative_to(allowed) for value in resolved.values()))
